entities.summary: Jorge Viterbo Ferreira is a Portuguese chess grandmaster. Viterbo Ferreira became a FIDE Master in 2010, an International Master in 2013, and a Grandmaster in 2018. He represented Portugal at the Chess Olympiad in 2012, 2014, 2016, 2022, and 2024. As of October 2024, Viterbo Ferreira is the highest FIDE rated Portuguese player. He was the fourth Portuguese player to obtain the Grandmaster title.
